verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own docs describe an internal 'agent' that reads user feedback submissions and proposes intentions/tasks (foreloop-docs-12, foreloop-docs-35), which is a built-in AI capability inside the product. However, the core task-execution workflow explicitly relies on external coding agents (Claude Code or Codex) that the user runs on their own machine, not a built-in assistant inside Foreloop itself (foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-37). Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose built-in assistant for arbitrary task delegation beyond feedback-triage, and any first-party UI/chat interface for directly instructing an in-product AI.
